adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /workflows with empty input. Official docs title the header X-API-KEY; native and pinned source send X-API-Key. Raw JSON is returned under data.
Optional name and cursor bind to official name and _ query parameters and are omitted when unset. Provider next hrefs are never followed. Raw JSON is returned under data.
workflowId is encoded as the path segment. Raw JSON is returned under data; the upstream connector unwraps response.data into workflow and is not preserved.

Optional workflowId, status, and cursor bind to workflowId, status, and _. Status is a caller-supplied comma-separated string rather than the upstream array join. Provider next hrefs are never followed.
workflowRunId is encoded as the path segment. Raw JSON is returned under data.
POST /workflows. Required share fields match official PUT/POST semantics.
PUT /workflows/{workflowId}.
DELETE /workflows/{workflowId}.
POST /workflow-runs.
PUT /workflow-runs/{workflowRunId}.
DELETE /workflow-runs/{workflowRunId}.
GET /workflow-runs/{workflowRunId}/tasks. Optional cursor binds to _.
GET /workflow-runs/{workflowRunId}/tasks/{taskId}.
PUT /workflow-runs/{workflowRunId}/tasks/{taskId}.
GET /comments. Optional filters bind to documented query names.
POST /comments.
GET /users.
GET /folders.
GET /webhooks.
POST /webhooks.
